title: Dativ — The Indirect Object
explanation: Dativ marks the indirect object — usually the person something is given to, done for, or happens to. Articles change: **der → dem, die → der, das → dem, die (plural) → den**. Common with verbs like *geben* (to give), *helfen* (to help), and *danken* (to thank).

examples.de: Ich gebe dem Mann das Buch.
examples.en: I give the book to the man.

exercises.prompt: Ich helfe ___ Mann. (I help the man.)
Which case is used for the person receiving something?
Ich gebe ___ Frau die Blumen. (to the woman)
